references.text: The same theme that one can chase a thousand, and two can chase ten thousand, when the Lord fights for his people
The promise that five of Israel's people will chase a hundred, and a hundred will chase ten thousand enemies
The Lord shall fight for you, and you shall be still - the same theme that God fights for his people
God's promise to send his terror before Israel and drive out the enemies
Moses exhorts Israel not to fear, for the Lord their God fights for them
An example of how the Lord fought for Israel in the war against the five Amorite kings
Confirmation that the God of Israel fought for Israel in the conquest of the land
Gideon's army was reduced to show that victory came from the Lord, not from human strength
The prophecy that a thousand will flee at the threat of one man, in contrast to the promise in Joshua
